Newly diagnosed patients: Unifocal, unilateral high-grade glioma based on MRI
Patients must have a prior confirmed histological/molecular diagnosis of GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: One is herpes simplex virus thymidine kinase (HSV-tk), which converts the pro-drug valaciclovir into an active drug that can kill tumour cells
[DRUG] Valaciclovir: Oral valaciclovir administered 3 times daily for 14 - 21 days

candidate_flag.reason: Only pharmacological agent besides the AAV gene therapy is valaciclovir, a prodrug activated by the gene-therapy-encoded HSV-tk; whether it counts as a candidate or as part of the excluded gene therapy system decides S6.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: further investigate the safety and efficacy in patients with newly diagnosed or recurrent Glioblastoma

combination_partners: standard of care surgery and chemoradiotherapy (newly diagnosed)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: incidence of HSV-tk mRNA expression, or equivalent, in tissue

role_evidence.quote: TGX-007 is a gene therapy drug delivered by a harmless adeno-associated virus (AAV) vector which delivers two combined therapeutic payloads

agents.drug_class_hint: TGX-007, AAV-1 vector gene therapy encoding HSV thymidine kinase and interleukin-12, intratumoural injection
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: delivers two combined therapeutic payloads to enable killing of proliferative cells and activation of an anti-tumour immune response

role_evidence.quote: Patients will receive TGX-007 by a direct intratumoural injection and will then take the pro-drug valacyclovir orally for up to 21 days before proceeding to standard of care surgery.

agents.drug_class_hint: antiviral nucleoside prodrug (aciclovir prodrug), used as HSV-tk-activated suicide-gene prodrug
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: herpes simplex virus thymidine kinase (HSV-tk), which converts the pro-drug valaciclovir into an active drug that can kill tumour cells

flag.reason: Valaciclovir's antitumour effect depends entirely on activation by the excluded gene therapy (suicide gene/prodrug system); candidate status needs adjudication.

coder_notes: AAV gene therapy (TGX-007, excluded type) plus oral valaciclovir as the HSV-tk-activated prodrug. Valaciclovir coded experimental_monotherapy (only pharmacological investigational agent, with a stated antitumour mechanism) but flagged uncertain because its activity requires the gene therapy; if judged part of the gene therapy system, S6 fails with excluded_intervention_type. Newly diagnosed cohort is 'high-grade glioma' on MRI; recurrent cohort requires GBM; GBM named in conditions, so mixed_glioma_gbm_named. Newly diagnosed patients proceed to Stupp chemoradiotherapy after surgery, but temozolomide is not a registered intervention and recurrent patients do not receive it, so it is not listed. HSV-tk mRNA in tissue is transgene expression (the prodrug-activating enzyme), coded target_engagement unclear; it is not a tumour biomarker. Three EXPERIMENTAL cohorts, none a control.
